## Disclaimers

- The is a preliminary model made to asses signal, not the most sophisticated possible approach.
- This has not yet been reviewed by clinical staff.
- Results may shift until the analysis plan (and thus the code) is finalized.
- The cohort is small; nothing here is externally validated.

## What we did

- Restricted the data to each patient's first (baseline) observation.
- Excluded post-treatment variables (based on non-expert review - this is an area where direct collaboration would be needed in the future for a final model).
- Excluded variables with >90% missing values, leaving just under 20 features in total.
- Predicted using patient-grouped nested cross-validation. Minimal missing data was imputed via fit in-fold only.

## What we saw

- In repeated cross-validation, the best model suggests that around 0.70 AUC may be achievable using baseline data alone, though this is preliminary.
- Performance is similar with fuller data (for the simpler models it is nearly unchanged), which suggests no late-observation leakage and means the model could potentially be deployed at intake.

- Verify feature selection and overall approach in direct communication with clinical experts

- Conduct a full, more sophisticated analysis using longitudinal approaches, neural networks, etc that leverage the full dataset.
